cultural.vision_reason: A printed yellow yantra cloth with Buddha image, Khom script text, and monk portraits, used to cover ordination stones (luknimit) in a Thai Buddhist ceremony — a traditional Thai ritual/religious textile.

physical.title: yantra
physical.summary: Yantra. Big Yellow Yantra Buddha and Three Monks.Yantra (magical diagram) printed on a yellow rectangular fabric used to cover what are called in Thai the luknimit, stones which designate the sacred space of the hall (uposatha) for ordinations and other Buddhist monastic ceremonies. The yantra has a large Buddha image in the center surrounded by text in Khom script arranged in a square. Around this square are arranged images of the Buddha’s disciples and small square diagrams with Khom script letters. The whole yantra is bordered by text in Khom script. Above the yantra is the name of the cloth and below are portrait busts of 3 monks. At the bottom are the occasion, location and date written in Thai. Printed.
